context: Revisit requested two weeks after the 2026-11-01 comparison. Suggested order: install pinned set and tracker adapter; retire overlapping code/test/todo actions as equivalents prove out; fold shared-change-framework, shared-review-protocol and shared-investigation-framework into AGENTS.md and docs/agent/; start GLOSSARY.md via domain-modeling; adopt a SCOPE.md-style bar (observed failure) for new local rules; prune AGENTS.md with writing-for-agents. implement-spec should run only through feature delivery mode until worktree-create supports a non-develop base and the integrator owns tracker claims.
description:
Goal: move from locally accreted skills (code, test, todo ideate/spec, shared-change-framework, shared-review-protocol, shared-investigation-framework) toward the widely used mattpocock/skills set (https://github.com/mattpocock/skills, reviewed at commit 59db609, MIT, ~305k stars), keeping only what that set deliberately excludes: write governance (worktrees, PR close-out, merge authority), the todo-db tracker mechanics, and BenchBox/personal skills (benchbox, blog, substack, tidy-perms, skill-sync, memex-search, session-takeover).

Candidate replacements: implement + tdd (code implement/fix/perf, test); diagnosing-bugs (code debug, investigation-framework root cause); code-review (code review / five-axis); grilling, grill-with-docs, to-spec, to-tickets, wayfinder (todo ideate/spec, code to-spec, batch decomposition); pr (PR body). New capability with no local equivalent: domain-modeling (GLOSSARY.md + ADRs), codebase-design, improve-codebase-architecture, prototype, research, retro, writing-for-agents.

todo-db as his tracker: choose 'Other' in /setup-matt-pocock-skills and write docs/agents/issue-tracker.md mapping ticket=item, Blocked by=needs, frontier=list_items(ready_only=true), claim=take, resolve=finish, needs-info=blocked, wontfix=drop. Specs stay as files in _project/specs/<slug>.md (landed by PR); tickets use id <slug>-NN-<short> with the spec path in links; optional umbrella item whose needs list every ticket. Gaps: no parent link, no needs-triage/ready-for-human labels, context is overwritten not appended (adapter must say append or defer).

Worktree/branch conflicts: (1) implement commits to the current branch; AGENTS.md must require make worktree-create first. (2) implement-spec bases implementer worktrees on an integration branch, but scripts/worktree_lifecycle.sh:160-163 always branches from origin/develop; needs an optional base, and the integrator must own take/prepare/finish (one live claim per worker identity). (3) prototype/* and wayfinder research/* branches are pushed and never merged, which conflicts with WRITE-CLOSEOUT-001. (4) his code-review/review fixed points default to main; ours is origin/develop. (5) his handoff writes to $TMPDIR, which conflicts with SESSION-STATE-001. (6) his to-spec forbids file paths; our spec guidance requires Prior art with paths (suggest: paths in spec file only).
